corrections.text: The article states Alphabet's SpaceX stake was diluted to between 4.9% and 5.0% 'after new shares were issued in SpaceX's initial public offering.' The cited MediaPost report actually attributes that dilution to an earlier, separate event: SpaceX's February 2026 merger absorbing xAI, stating 'Equity dilution in SpaceX occurred in February 2026, when it completed a merger absorbing Musk's AI startup, xAI... This brought Google's effective equity share down to between 4.9% to 5.0% by the time of the public listing.' The 4.9%-5.0% figure is correct; the cause was the xAI merger, not new shares issued in the June 2026 IPO.
